systems.system: SIGE (Système d'Information pour la Gestion de l'Éducation)
systems.platform: DHIS2, added on top of CSPro with StatEduc for the annual school census
systems.owner: Ministry of education, implemented with HISP West and Central Africa
systems.tiers: National, regional and inspection levels of the education ministry; in use at regional level, with devices in short supply and training not refreshed at inspection level

note: An education ministry information system used in the ministry's own regional and inspection offices, not in local governments; no local government office connection is stated.
